description: Correct a capability test (write — editor). Only passed fields change; none can be cleared. findings sent here are added. The result must still agree with the findings.

findings.description: Findings to add with this correction. Existing findings are managed as deficiencies

owner_user_id.description: Owner user — must be a member of the organisation (404 otherwise); see scf_list_members

priority.description: Priority: critical, high, medium, low (platform default medium)

risk_code.description: Risk the finding is against, if any — must be assessed

scf_id.description: Control the finding is against, if any — must be in scope (422 otherwise)

title.description: Short title of the finding (1–255 chars, non-blank)

outcome.description: What happened, and what was learned

result.description: Result: passed, passed_with_findings, failed. Checked against recorded findings (cancelled excluded) plus any sent here; to correct passed to failed, send the result and a finding together

test_id.description: Capability test UUID — obtain from scf_list_capability_tests

test_type.description: Kind of test: incident_response, continuity, other

tested_on.description: Day the test was run (YYYY-MM-DD); not in the future

name: scf_update_capability_test
